feedback: Vincent's confession follows the previously available evidence closely: genuine bottle at the preview, later access to the waiting glass, and a false model-substitution defense contradicted by delivery and image records. The explicit admission of taking poison during the preview supplies the precise action, but does not introduce a new decisive fact needed to identify him. His envy of Dada and humiliation by Grant were already present, making the motive emotionally coherent even though the jump to murder remains extreme. Barb and Chip's responses also connect to their documented misconduct rather than distracting with new surprises. The ending feels earned and concise, with Vincent accepting responsibility instead of treating artistic grievance as an excuse.
